outcome: causes of death (gastrointestinal diseases, circulatory system diseases, neoplasms, other organ system diseases)
cohort: The study population comprised 571 women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) and 1333 matched controls from Tampere University Hospital, Finland.
finding: Women with a history of ICP do not have an increased overall mortality, but deaths from gastrointestinal diseases are overrepresented among them.
